comment: Free-LLM provider rotation for the task worker. Two gates, both fail-closed. (1) Human approval: a provider may only run agentic work when tier is 'approved'. The numeric score is advisory because the blended agentic score misranks models: in the 2026-08-16 snapshot gpt-oss-20b scores 61.1 while MiniMax-M3 scores 42.1, which does not match their real agentic-coding behaviour. (2) Numeric floor: the score must still meet min_agentic_coding_score (set to MiniMax-M3's measured 42.1, the stated quality bar). Providers marked 'utility' are fine for short non-agentic jobs (titles, summaries) and are never selected for issue implementation.

quality_policy.note: Blended percentages mix incompatible benchmarks, so they are necessary but not sufficient. Approval requires a review of the underlying benchmark columns and real-world agentic results.

providers.note: Rejected by the owner for agentic coding: old and unreliable on multi-step work despite the blended score. Allowed only for short utility tasks in a different context.
No measured agentic-coding score in the snapshot. Candidate for approval once scored.
Key expired 2026-10-01 after CI overuse; disabled by the provider owner.
